cases.prompt: Review the field encryption code for nonce safety. src/crypto/fieldCipher.ts line 9 loads one long-lived key from disk: `const key = fs.readFileSync('/etc/app/field.key')`. Line 12 declares `let counter = 0;` at module scope, and line 18 builds the nonce from it: `const iv = Buffer.alloc(12); iv.writeUInt32BE(counter++, 8);` before line 19 calls `crypto.createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, iv)`. The process restarts on every deploy, so the counter returns to zero while the persisted key stays the same. Security purpose: confidentiality and integrity of stored customer fields.
